name: session_id
description: Unique session identifier, e.g. S00012345. bookings.session_id points here when a booking was completed inside a tracked web session.

name: session_date
description: Calendar date of the session (UTC). Partition column.

name: customer_id
description: The signed-in customer, or NULL for an anonymous visitor. Joins to customers.customer_id.

name: channel
description: Marketing channel that brought the session: one of paid_search, paid_social, organic, email, direct, affiliate. paid_social includes the always-on retargeting program.

name: device
description: Device category: mobile, desktop or tablet.

name: landing_category
description: Product category of the landing page (warm_escape, city_break, ski, adventure, cruise) or home for the homepage.

name: destinations_viewed
description: Destination ids viewed during the session, in order, e.g. [DST-007, DST-012]. Joins to destinations.destination_id.

name: primary_category_viewed
description: The product category the session mostly browsed: one of warm_escape (winter and early-spring sun getaways, our signature category), city_break, ski, adventure, cruise.

name: viewed_warm_escape
description: TRUE when at least one warm-escape destination was viewed in the session. Use this to find customers who browsed warm escapes.

name: pages_viewed
description: Number of pages viewed in the session.

name: searched_travel_month
description: First day of the travel month the visitor searched for (e.g. 2027-02-01 for February 2027), or NULL if no dates were entered.

name: added_to_cart
description: TRUE when the visitor added a package to the cart.

name: converted
description: TRUE when a booking was completed inside this session. Conversion rate = COUNTIF(converted) / COUNT(*). Anonymous sessions are always FALSE.
